folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B389: scoped evidence and current stack direction
folds.body:
The complete ER7 report and every numeric table/operation boundary were read. Preserve the controls: cached active arrays can avoid inactive scans without an ECS; membership invalidation/churn has an actual cost not measured here. S1's p95 is a batch-average per-tick tail, not a single tick. Dense miniplex iteration is not a universal faster loop, and a tiny100k invented needs kernel does not establish whole-world simulation cost. Heavy unmatched host load, no forced GC and differing loop styles prevent stable CPU/energy/latency conclusions.

S2 distinguishes a prepacked transfer echo from the full encode/message/decode/step/result boundary, with cold worker startup separate. Ownership transfer removes copying, not object reconstruction; a worker can improve UI availability while total response time grows. Retained simulation state plus bounded command/result patches was proposed, not measured. S3's deterministic repetitive Unicode envelope is a shape model that never called the real validators/loader. The Map string sink is not localStorage/disk durability. In-memory SQLite transaction/rollback, exported image size and a ten-actor patch do not establish OPFS, storage-full/crash recovery or apples-to-apples whole-snapshot speed. Base64 bytes and encoding time differ, and two-generation shared-guard arithmetic is not a measured browser quota failure.

Codec identity/decoded-size limits, native reconstruction, old-reader behavior, frozen paid jobs/cursors and one durable publisher remain consequential if a format is selected. Compression does not decide history deletion or entitlement. All old package versions, source references, zero-vulnerability install report, hardware/load values and raw result paths retain their original dates; no external claim was refreshed. Current [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md) retires the one-realm/one-prestige gate and uses current desktop targets; AD39 chooses Electron plus web. EG0/worker/codec/SQLite/Rust hypotheses remain research proposals under AD32, not migration or a repeated benchmark mandate. No runtime, source fetch, dependency, browser or save was exercised here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B389: scoped evidence and current stack direction
folds.body:
This full321-line comparison, every source/count/cost/option row and later switch gates were read. The459-file/97803physical-line census is an old exclusive path classification, not a semantic dependency count, a port percentage or a promise that data factories transfer unchanged. Person-week ranges are uncertain planning heuristics with omitted release/content/taste work, not quotes, current schedules or throughput that divides by agent count. A narrow successor dropping systems is a new scope, not a completed equivalent port.

Preserve useful contracts independently of engine brand: stable domain IDs, exact RNG order/number/null/missing semantics, retained compiled story identity/cursors, actor-qualified read models, no renderer-owned money/time, source/content revisions, stale/canceled bridge results and awaited durable acknowledgment before live publication. A Rust/ECS handle is not a save identity. A physics frame or statechart timer is not the causal scheduler; a desktop wrapper does not automatically move origin storage, remove the application guard or award closed/sleep time. Renderer islands need actual native commands, lifecycle/teardown, accessible text/control and saved-preference behavior.

The Tauri-first/Electron-fallback and old viewport recommendations are historical: current AD39 and [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md) choose Electron plus web and current desktop targets. Keep Tauri, Godot, renderer, Rust and other engine options as unselected alternatives for a demonstrated gap. No whole-game migration follows from a brand/editor/empty-export comparison. Proposed50percent/2x/100ms/50ms switch bars were not achieved or adopted universal thresholds. Current AD51 allows a useful first seam rather than a broad framework prerequisite; AD42 makes human taste optional.

External engine versions, web export limits, licenses, seat/pricing rules, release dates and plugin support are attributed October14 observations and unresolved metadata, not freshly verified legal/current-product guidance. Vendor empty-engine charts, codec mismatch, raw/gzip/Wasm asset differences and historical Godot size remain incomparable to a full game. No primary page, export, installation, API, benchmark, current dependency or source was reopened here. Any selected future adoption needs its own matching consumer, platform, compatibility and failure evidence.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B389: scoped evidence and current stack direction
folds.body:
The full224-line catalog was read, recovering the truncated middle output in bounded chunks. All X/I/N/V/S/H families, source-trace cells, XE-CONT1 and ten proposed patterns retain their exact historical provenance. Linked source reads and metadata are claims of the original lane, not new primary-source reading by this pass. Release/tag/branch/push/access dates, missing license notices and unresolved version conflicts remain distinct; no current package/license/API availability is asserted.

Preserve the specific reusable patterns: batch committed view notifications and clean listener ownership; refresh all actually visible independent panels rather than importing a single-tab layout; restore records/references before observers activate without RNG/time/reward grants; derive help and validation from the actual named operation schema. Visible-but-locked can explain a public known cause while unseen remains undisclosed. Eligibility, candidate selection and paid effect commit are three operations; seeing/hovering does not select or draw. The scene/history transcript is not world history or a durable transaction log.

IGT fakeTick omits lifecycle bookkeeping, a worker alarm may still run ticks on the main thread, peer bulk redshift needs actual dependency/boundary equivalence, and a shrinking offline bank can lose accounting before a later clamp. None supplies OOPS clock policy. A restored statechart restarting an invocation needs actual idempotent host effects; a cached fact/index must track committed revisions and observer knowledge. In-memory query transactions and CRDT convergence do not conserve paid stock, command cursors or elapsed rewards by themselves. Raw explorer/authoring data cannot be projected to players as known facts.

The catalog's one-realm milestone and Tauri-first shell preference are superseded by [current PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md) and AD39; current AD44/51/52 keep developer lead-first, useful shared seams and consequence-preserving compressed long play. Library/host/tool alternatives remain optional reference, not simultaneous work orders or dependency installs. Future source/price/license claims need fresh evidence only when a concrete adoption selects them; this reconciliation makes no external recommendation or legal certification. AD42 makes human review optional, while a selected runtime change retains its actual native/persistence/failure gate. No new framework, package, source collection, runtime or benchmark was run.
